name: report-workbench-dev
description: Development-only tooling for the Report Workbench tests. The application itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies: everything it ships is vendored under builder/web/assets/v2/vendor/. Every builder/tests/test_v2_* file has a script of its own here and appears in test:v2-all; a new one is added to both in the same commit, or nothing runs it.

scripts.test:v2-all: npm run test:v2-api && npm run test:v2-numeric && npm run test:v2-rename-guard && npm run test:v2 && npm run test:v2-over-spec && npm run test:v2-over-spec-scope && npm run test:v2-load-race && npm run test:v2-card-move && npm run test:v2-grid-drag && npm run test:v2-assets && npm run test:v2-restart-flush && npm run test:v2-sync-flush-guard && npm run test:v2-export-stale && npm run test:v2-apply-update-shelf && npm run test:v2-grid-menu && npm run test:v2-card-delete-guard && npm run test:v2-trash-restore && npm run test:v2-menu-scroll && npm run test:v2-asset-insert && npm run test:v2-preview-follow && npm run test:v2-home-rail && npm run test:v2-diagnostics && npm run test:v2-figure-swap
